The '''Iego system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|system]] located within the [[Ash Worlds/Legends|Ash Worlds]] sector in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iego/Legends|Iego]], a rogue planetoid in the [[Extrictarium Nebula/Legends|Extrictarium Nebula]] with no primary [[Star/Legends|star]], but a number of moonlets orbiting it.

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the system was visited by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and Anakin Skywalker during their [[Mission to Iego/Legends|mission]] to obtain [[Reeksa/Legends|reeksa]] root.

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]] confirmed that the Iego and [[Thousand Moons system/Legends|Thousand Moons systems]] are two different systems. This separation was made due to Anakin and Padmé wearing the Thousand Moons system's fashions while posing as refugees in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Attack of the Clones'']] and therefore would not be wearing clothing from a system of legend.<ref>{{JCFCite|url=posts/30696931|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfry]]|date=2010-01-16|time=7:30 AM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200802110726/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-essential-atlas-and-galactic-cartography-official-discussion.21938930/page-134}}</ref>
